### Understanding God
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/understanding-god-one-year-devotions-for-men-june-23.html
Passage: Exodus 33:11
Points:
- Scientific knowledge of the universe has rapidly expanded, but mankind's intimate knowledge of God has not kept pace.
- Material and technological wealth frequently tempts people to prioritize the creation over the Creator.
- God places intentional limits on His self-revelation because mortal human beings cannot bear His full majesty.
- An unfulfilled longing to know God fully points to eternity, where believers will ultimately see Him face-to-face.

### Face to Face with a Friend
Author: Jill Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-women/face-to-face-with-a-friend-one-year-devotions-for-women-january-18.html
Passage: Exodus 33:11, 17
Points:
- Moses maintained a dedicated daily discipline of seeking God despite the crushing weight of leadership responsibilities.
- Moses did not guard intimacy with God as an exclusive privilege, making the Tent of Meeting open to anyone seeking the Lord.
- Meeting God face-to-face models honest, open, and authentic prayer where believers can lay out their real needs.
- Nurturing a close friendship with God fills the heart to overflowing, enabling healthy human relationships to thrive.
